page.text:
The integer represented by a pair $(a,b)$ of natural numbers is the
formal difference $a-b$. The structured realization above defines the
equivalence relation, quotient carrier, and induced operations. Its
well-definedness obligations ensure that changing representatives does
not change a sum or product.
